goal: Procedural asset generation pipeline — materials, mechanical parts, architectural elements — from script to GLB, version-controlled, game-engine ready, with automated validation and deployment
author: Guinea Pig Trench LLC

checkpoints.name: Supine — Single Generator Script
checkpoints.flashcard: First asset. One script. Does it run headless? Yes. Does it export GLB? Yes. Can a game engine load it? Yes. The pipeline exists.

checkpoints.name: Scoot — Material Library Foundation
checkpoints.flashcard: Upper body pulls. Materials aren't baked into scripts — they're imported from a shared library. Ferrous, non-ferrous, wood, concrete, industrial, painted. Any generator can call get_material().

checkpoints.name: Crawl — Mechanical Parts Family
checkpoints.deliverable: generate_gear.py + generate_pulley.py (3 pulley variants: vbelt, flat crowned, timing)
checkpoints.flashcard: Cross-pattern coordination. Involute gear with actual tooth geometry — pressure angle, addendum, dedendum, root fillet. Not a cylinder with bumps. A real involute profile. Three pulley types share one script.

checkpoints.name: Stand — Architectural Elements
checkpoints.deliverable: generate_elevator.py + generate_staircase.py output verified as GLB
checkpoints.flashcard: Full upright. Elevator with steel cage, cable drum, sliding doors. Staircase with dual stringers, 14 treads, pipe handrails, rivets. Both export as game-ready GLB from headless Blender.

checkpoints.name: Walk — Automated Build Pipeline
checkpoints.deliverable: build_all_assets.py — 6/6 GLBs regenerated in 8.7s, validated, copied to dist/
checkpoints.flashcard: Reciprocal gait. Change module in generate_gear.py, run one command, and gear_5m_30t.glb appears alongside gear_3m_24t.glb. All 6 assets regenerated in sequence. No manual Blender UI.

checkpoints.name: Jump — Validation & Integrity Checks
checkpoints.deliverable: validate_assets.py — checks GLB file size > 0, mesh count within expected range, material count, non-degenerate geometry
checkpoints.flashcard: First intentional flight. A generated GLB could be 0 bytes, have 0 meshes, or be missing materials. The validator catches this before it reaches the game engine. CI-ready.

checkpoints.name: Run — Game Engine Integration
checkpoints.deliverable: assets_viewer.html — Three.js viewer with all 6 assets, orbit controls, shadows, HUD
checkpoints.flashcard: Sustained flight. Assets aren't just files — they're visible in the game. Elevator doors slide. Staircase has collision. Gear meshes with another gear. Pulley has a belt.

checkpoints.name: Leap — Parametric Variant Matrix
checkpoints.deliverable: Generate 3+ variants of each asset type from parameter sweeps. gear_3m_24t + gear_4m_16t + gear_5m_12t. pulley_vbelt D=80,120,160mm.

checkpoints.name: Fly — Version-Controlled Asset Registry
checkpoints.deliverable: asset_registry.json — every GLB tracked with source script hash, generation date, parameter snapshot, and validation status
checkpoints.flashcard: Full autonomy. Git commit hooks trigger regeneration if source scripts change. CI validates all assets. The registry tells you which GLB came from which script version.

checkpoints.name: Soar — Cross-Project Deployment
checkpoints.deliverable: Assets deployed to hyperpoly-terrain, Thrown Planet, and Trench Builder from single source of truth
checkpoints.flashcard: Total continuity. One material library. One gear generator. One elevator. Used across every project. Change oak_varnished roughness in material_library.py and every project's GLBs update on next build.

microtasks.name: Write build_all_assets.py
microtasks.result: 6/6 GLBs rebuilt in 9.7s. All passed GLB header validation.

microtasks.name: Add --output-dir flag to all generators
microtasks.result: All 4 generators accept ASSET_OUTPUT_DIR env var. build_all_assets.py passes it through to Blender subprocess.

microtasks.name: Write validate_assets.py — GLB integrity
microtasks.description: Read GLB binary header. Check magic bytes (0x46546C67). Check JSON chunk parses. Check BIN chunk length > 0. Report: file size, mesh count, material count, node count, animation count (should be 0 for static assets).
microtasks.result: Standalone validate_assets.py with --strict and --summary modes. 6/6 pass. Reports mesh/material/node counts.

microtasks.name: Add mesh count assertion to generators
microtasks.result: validate_assets.py --summary shows mesh counts per file: Staircase 205, Elevator 59, Gear 1, Pulleys 1 each. Counts verified against expected ranges.

microtasks.name: Create Three.js GLB loader demo page
microtasks.description: Single HTML file that imports THREE.js GLTFLoader, loads elevator.glb and staircase.glb, positions them side by side, adds OrbitControls, ambient + directional lighting. Proves assets render correctly in target engine.
microtasks.result: assets_viewer.html — Three.js viewer with orbit controls, ACES filmic tone mapping, shadow maps, keyboard shortcuts (1-6). All 6 assets load and render.

microtasks.name: Generate gear variant matrix
microtasks.description: Run generate_gear.py with MODULE=[2, 3, 4, 5] × TEETH=[16, 20, 24] producing 12 gear variants. Verify all have correct pitch diameters and tooth counts.

microtasks.name: Generate pulley variant matrix
microtasks.description: Run generate_pulley.py with PULLEY_TYPE=[vbelt, flat_crowned, timing] × PITCH_DIAMETER=[80, 120, 160] producing 9 pulley variants.

microtasks.name: Create asset_registry.json schema
microtasks.description: Define JSON schema for the registry: asset name, source script, source script SHA256, generation timestamp, parameters used, GLB file SHA256, mesh count, material list, validation status, game engine compatibility.

microtasks.name: Wire regeneration into git pre-commit hook
microtasks.description: If any generate_*.py or material_library.py changed in the staged commit, run build_all_assets.py and validate_assets.py. Block commit if validation fails. Add generated GLBs to the commit automatically.

microtasks.name: Deploy assets to hyperpoly-terrain project
microtasks.description: Copy gear and pulley GLBs to hyperpoly-terrain/assets/. Add import in hyperpoly-terrain's asset loader. Verify gear meshes against terrain simulation voxel scale. Document in hyperpoly-terrain README.
microtasks.deliverable: hyperpoly-terrain/assets/ with gear + pulley GLBs, updated loader
microtasks.result: 19 GLBs deployed (12 gears + 7 pulleys). GLTFLoader integrated into game/index.html with auto-detected DEPLOY_TO fallback in build_all_assets.py. README updated with cross-project pipeline docs.

summary.next_action: MT6 — generate gear variant matrix (15 min, unblocks AP8)
